note: A polygon filled with a picture the style never carried: the page fetches one, adds it under a name, and asks `fill-pattern` for it. Nothing else in the suite paints a fill from an added image. The two renderers reach the picture at different moments and that is the point -- the oracle has it before its first frame, this side is handed it after the tiles are built, which is when the page hands it over too. It reads 24403: the oracle tiles the silhouette through the polygon and this draws a solid black rectangle, because a pattern a tile could not resolve is written into that tile's vertices as the zero rectangle and stays there.
